scope.title: SUPPLY AND DELIVERY OF SEWERAGE WATER PUMPS SPARES & INSTRUMENTS STOCK ITEMS FOR A PERIOD OF 36 MONTHS
scope.buys: The tender buys the supply and delivery of sewerage water pump spares and instrumentation stock items over a 36-month period for Abaqulusi Municipality.
scope.why: The company specialises in supplying and servicing submersible and centrifugal water and sewage pumps, spares and instrumentation to municipalities, is CSD registered and has eight years' experience in exactly this line of work.
